title: Populate structured turn trace fields from real turns
description: Review finding from loreweaver-1ek. Orchestration records turn traces but leaves expected fields such as rulesResolution, acceptedStateDelta, rejectedCandidates, memoryUpdates, corrections, and flags as placeholders. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator trace tests assert non-placeholder fields for turns with roll and mutate_state calls; accepted and rejected state deltas, rules/tool outcomes, memory updates, and quality flags are recorded when available.
